text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...The voyage I dreamed of shone far 
brighter than this."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And yet, dark clouds hung low in the sky, 
and I was constantly thwarted by rough 
seas and storms—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Navigator. What do I need to do to 
reach Treasure Island?
choice_data_list:
Let's keep up the hard work you've put in 
so far.
Let's train even harder than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What's!? Is that really going to work!?
choice_data_list:
If you push yourself too hard, your dream 
will slip further away.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list:
I'll chart a clear course for us, so 
please trust me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. No one who doesn't trust their 
crew could ever claim the treasure!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I won't let any hardship beat me! I swear 
I'll reach Treasure Island one day!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Compared to today's frustration, any 
future trial will be nothing more than 
child's play in the shallows!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Please, make sure you don't hold back, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's the spirit! Even if the mast 
breaks or the tides toss us around, we 
keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Until I get my hands on that gold, I'll 
keep right on dancing, even in the sunless 
depths of the sea!
